title: KHR_character_expression glTF Document Extension
description: Associates character-expression entries with animations used as normalized, stateless response curves.

expressions.description: Nonempty array of expression entries with unique nonempty names. Array indices are the authoritative entry identities.
expressions.gltf_detailedDescription: All entry names MUST be distinct by Unicode code point, without case folding, trimming, or Unicode normalization. Name uniqueness requires semantic validation beyond this schema.
